brief: 물을 뺀 1970년대 실내 수영장을 고친 안경 매장. 물은 없고 빛만 출렁인다. 계단을 내려가 빈 수조 바닥을 걷는다.

facts: A floor strip (entryway staircase landing) runs 4.7 m from the door toward the hero (fragmented prismatic light source).
The hero stands alone 5.6 m inside the door, 3.5 m tall; nothing else rises above 1.8 m.
Four product stations (product display monoliths) ring it loosely, 0.4 m from the route at the closest.
The pay counter (polished payment desk) sits at the back right, where the route ends.
anchors: just inside the door, looking down at the floor strip; you look at the entryway staircase landing (floor_patch)
in front of the hero; you look at the fragmented prismatic light source (basin)
low, close to a product station; you look at the product display monoliths (display)

materials.where: walls, entryway staircase landing, polished payment desk

args.title: The Drained Pool Gallery
args.subtitle: A 1970s sanctuary reclaimed by light.
args.line: Descend into the hollow of a forgotten pool where light is the only remaining fluid.
args.synopsis: You step down into the raw concrete expanse of a drained 1970s indoor pool, where the familiar echoes of water are replaced by a profound, silent stillness. At the center of the deep, you encounter the fragmented prismatic light source, a basin of brilliance that shatters the dim, cavernous atmosphere. You weave between mineral-white monoliths displaying eyewear, each station catching the spectral reflections cast across the clay floor. The journey concludes at the back, where the polished concrete desk awaits in the soft, glowing fog.
args.quote: To empty the space is to fill it with vision.

why.d: The landing invites you to descend, shifting your perception from the street level to the subterranean floor of the pool.
This basin acts as the physical embodiment of water, turning light into a tangible presence in the empty room.
These stations create a meditative path that mimics the movement of currents, guiding you naturally toward the product.
The final point of rest provides a grounding finish to your underwater journey.
